title: Federal Government Approves King Amachree Airport Project in Degema
text:
Federal Government Approves King Amachree Airport Project in Degema
The Nigerian Federal Government has approved the development of the proposed King Amachree Airport at Elem Ifoko, Degema Local Government Area. The approval, addressed to Royal Fouche Services Limited, mandates the submission of a comprehensive Master Plan and strict compliance with Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority regulations, environmental laws, and detailed engineering surveys regarding topography, hydrology, and canal infrastructure.
The Federal Government has approved the development and construction of the proposed King Amachree Airport at Elem Ifoko, Degema Local Government Area ofThe approval is contained in a letter dated October 26 and addressed to the Executive Director of Royal Fouche Services Limited, Prince Tonye Princewill.
Signed by the Director on behalf of the Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, the letter said the proponents of the airport must include preparation and submission of a comprehensive Airport Master Plan detailing the proposed development, phasing, facilities, and associated infrastructure. The letter also said they should strictly comply with all applicable requirements of the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority , compliance with all applicable environmental laws, regulations, and standards, such as conducting an Environmental Impact Assessment and other relevant environmental studies and payment of all applicable statutory fees.
Besides, they are to provide a detailed topographical and obstacle survey referenced to the World Gecdetic System 1984 , and a comprehensive geotechnical investigation to assess the site’s subsurface conditions, soil-bearing capacity, groundwater characteristics and overall suitability for the proposed aerodrome infrastructure. Other conditions include provision of detailed hydrological, hydraulic and drainage studies to assess and address flooding risks, tidal influences, seasonal water movements and storm water management requirements at the proposed airport site, provision of a detailed engineering assessment of the canal traversing the proposed airport site to determine the most suitable solution, whether through diversion or realignment of the canal, or the construction of an appropriate bridge or other suitable crossing structure.
It also includes the development of a suitable, reliable, all-weather road access to the proposed airport to support construction, airport operations, emergency response and passenger and cargo movement and the provision of a formal wind rose analysis and detailed meteorological assessment in consultation with the Nigerian Meteorological Agency . They are also to ensure the continuous involvement of the ministry and its relevant agencies throughout the stages of the airport development to provide the necessary technical oversight and ensure compliance with applicable ICAO Standards and Recommended Practices , the Nigerian Civil Aviation Regulations , and other relevant statutory and regulatory requirements.
